subject: Credit tranche overrun settlement (proposal)
messages:
From: Sara Cole <sara@fathomai.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Lin <procurement@fathomai.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: mid-week capacity spike — temporary uplift and reconciliation ask

Hi Hiro,

We just onboarded a large new enterprise customer and are seeing a 2–3x token surge in inference traffic starting this morning. Our engineering team expects the elevated load to last ~48 hours while the traffic pattern stabilizes.

Can Redwood provisionally bump our throughput and temporary quota by 2x for the next 48 hours? We need an approach that:
- guarantees the uplift immediately (no 24–48h provisioning lag),
- caps the maximum overrun rate so we can forecast spend, and
- allows reconciliation afterwards (we prefer a credit/refund if the uplift wasn’t fully used).

If possible, please send a short proposal with the uplift cadence, the provisional charge, and how refunding would work — we can route a PO quickly. I’ve attached a short runbook describing the spike.

Thanks,
Sara Cole
Head of ML Ops, Fathom AI
Attachments: fathomai-q1-runbook.xlsx

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cole <sara@fathomai.com>
Cc: Michael Lin <procurement@fathomai.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: mid-week capacity spike — temporary uplift and reconciliation ask

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and the runbook. We can act quickly. High-level option I can authorize from the hosted stack (immediate, no infra change required):

Option A — Credit tranche (fastest)
- Immediate provisional uplift: +2x quota for 48 hours
- Charge: provisional tranche = estimated overrun at base rate × 1.2 (20% operational buffer) billed upfront as a credit on the account
- Reconciliation: any unused portion of the tranche refunded as a credit on the next invoice; if actual overrun > tranche, overrun billed at capped surcharge (1.5x base rate)

Option B — Surge invoice (no upfront)
- Immediate uplift enabled with automated metering
- Overrun billed at 1.5x base rate on next invoice (no refund mechanism)

For both options we can add a one-time 10% concession on overrun fees for this incident (internal approval pending). I’ll loop in Finance and Sales to confirm PO flow and legal.

If you can send a PO (even provisional), we’ll lock Option A and apply the tranche immediately. I’ll attach a provisional invoice draft and a DocuSign amendment link for countersign.

- Hiro Tanaka
Account Director, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-provisional-invoice-draft.pdf; DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ZX3-abc123

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: mid-week capacity spike — provisional uplift (need pricing sign-off)

Laura / Ben / Grace — forwarding a live ask from Fathom AI (DEAL-4591). Summary: immediate 48h +2x uplift. Proposed approach is a provisional "credit tranche" charged up front (estimate ×1.2) with refund for unused credit; capped overrun surcharge at 1.5x if tranche exhausted. I’ve tentatively offered a 10% concession on overrun fees — needs your OK.

Questions:
- Ben: if we accept tranche approach, what discount band can we reasonably offer on the surcharge for a long‑standing customer?
- Grace: can Finance do the refund-as-credit flow on next month’s invoice and accept a provisional invoice + PO? Any timing concerns?

Need a quick decision (within 2–3 hours) so we can provision and avoid throttling Fathom’s production traffic.

On Wed, 28 Mar 2028 at 10:05 AM, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and the runbook...

— Hiro

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: mid-week capacity spike — provisional uplift (need pricing sign-off)

Quick take from Pricing/Ops: we can greenlight Option A (credit tranche) with the following guardrails — legal and Finance to sign off, but commercially acceptable: 

- Provisional tranche = estimated overrun tokens × base unit price × 1.15 (15% buffer) — smaller buffer than your 20% to keep it customer-friendly.
- Surcharge cap at 1.5x base unit price while tranche is in effect; if tranche is exhausted, we bill overrun at 1.5x but allow a post-incident reconciliation window of 30 days to request refunds.
- Concession: apply a 10% discount on the surcharge for this incident (one-time).
- PO acceptance: Finance can take a provisional invoice + PO and apply the tranche as a credit. Grace, please confirm timeline for issuing refunds/credits to their account.

Related links: HubSpot DEAL-4591: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-4591
Invoice draft: https://redwood-internal/drive/invoices/DEAL-4591-provisional.pdf

If ok, we will issue the provisional invoice and enable the uplift immediately once we have PO# and countersign on the DocuSign.

— Ben

From: Sara Cole <sara@fathomai.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Lin <procurement@fathomai.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credit tranche overrun settlement (proposal)

Hiro / Ben / Grace — thank you, this is helpful. Fathom AI will accept Option A (credit tranche) with the 1.5x cap and the 10% incident concession. We are sending a provisional PO now (attached) — PO# 4567.

Key asks from procurement:
- Please confirm the exact amount of the provisional tranche (we’ll wire the payment once we have the invoice)
- Please confirm the DocuSign amendment (we need to countersign before 5pm PT today)

Attaching PO and our procurement contact for payment: Michael Lin <procurement@fathomai.com> (attached pdf).

Thanks,
Sara Cole
Head of ML Ops, Fathom AI
Attachments: fathomai-po-4567.pdf

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credit tranche overrun settlement (proposal) — confirmed and next steps

Sara / Michael — confirmed. Next steps: 
1) Ben/Finance will issue a provisional invoice for the tranche (estimate attached). Amount = $22,800 (this is the estimated overrun at base unit price ×1.15 buffer).
2) Michael, if you can route PO#4567 against the provisional invoice and confirm wire timeline, we will: enable the +2x uplift immediately and lock the 48-hour window.
3) DocuSign: I’ve kicked the amendment to the email on the docusign link Ben shared; countersign by 5pm PT and we’re live.
4) Reconciliation: unused tranche credited on next invoice; if actual overrun > tranche, we bill at capped 1.5x rate and apply the 10% incident concession to the surcharge portion.

Grace, please proceed with provisional invoice issuance and mark the account for a 30-day reconciliation window. Laura/Ben — please flag if Legal needs further contract language; otherwise we’ll proceed.

Thanks everyone — provisioning will start within 15 minutes of PO confirmation.

— Hiro Tanaka
Account Director, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-provisional-invoice-draft.pdf
